# A. Literature Overview

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)


data_literature <- read_csv(
  "../data/tables/appendix/A_literature_overview.csv"
)

# data_literature <- read_csv(
#   "data/tables/appendix/literature_overview.csv"
# )

# glimpse(literature)

semicolon_to_bullets <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    grepl(";", x, fixed = TRUE),
    paste0(
      "• ",
      gsub(";", "<br>• ", x, fixed = TRUE)
    ),
    x
  )
}

bold_price_type <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\(S\\)", "**(S)**", x)
  x <- gsub("\\(R\\)", "**(R)**", x)
  x
}

literature_table <- data_literature |>
  mutate(
    reference = paste0("[@", reference, "]"),
    location = semicolon_to_bullets(location),
    variable_of_interest = semicolon_to_bullets(variable_of_interest),
    price_type = semicolon_to_bullets(price_type),
    data_period = semicolon_to_bullets(data_period),
    sample_size = bold_price_type(semicolon_to_bullets(sample_size))
  ) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(
    reference = "Reference",
    country = "Country",
    location = "Location",
    variable_of_interest = "Variable of interest",
    price_type = "Type of price",
    data_period = "Data period",
    sample_size = "Sample Size"
    # sample_size = gt::html(
    #   "Sample size<br>(S) - Sales Price<br>(R) - Rental Price"
    # )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(
        weight = "bold",
        size = gt::px(16)
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(
        columns = gt::everything()
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    footnote = gt::md("**(S)** = Sales price; **(R)** = Rental price"),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(
        columns = sample_size
    )
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(
    columns = c(
      reference,
      location,
      variable_of_interest,
      price_type,
      data_period,
      sample_size
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_header(
    title = "Literature Review - Overview"
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = gt::everything()
  ) |>
  gt::tab_options(
    table.width = gt::pct(100),
    table.font.size = gt::px(14),
    data_row.padding = gt::px(5)
  )

literature_table

```







# B. Calorific Values

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

calorific_values <- read_csv(
  "../data/tables/appendix/B_calorific_values.csv"
)
# calorific_values <- read_csv(
#   "data/tables/appendix/B_calorific_values.csv"
# )

calorific_values_table <- calorific_values |>
    mutate(
        unit = if_else(unit == "m3", "m³", unit)
    ) |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::cols_label(
        Energy_source = "Energy source",
        unit = "Unit",
        weight_in_kg = "Weight (kg)",
        kwh_per_unit = "Energy content (kWh/unit)",
        co2kg_per_unit = gt::html(
            "CO<sub>2</sub> emissions<br>(kg CO<sub>2</sub>/unit)"
        ),
        co2kg_per_kwh = gt::html(
            "CO<sub>2</sub> emissions<br>(kg CO<sub>2</sub>/kWh)"
    )
    ) |>
    gt::sub_missing(
        columns = gt::everything(),
        missing_text = "—"
    ) |>
    gt::tab_style(
        style = gt::cell_text(
            weight = "bold",
            size = gt::px(16)
        ),
        locations = gt::cells_column_labels(
            columns = gt::everything()
    )
    ) |>
    gt::tab_header(
        title = "Calorific values and CO₂ emission factors"
    ) |>
    gt::cols_align(
        align = "left",
        columns = gt::everything()
    ) |>
    gt::tab_options(
        table.width = gt::pct(100),
        table.font.size = gt::px(15),
        data_row.padding = gt::px(5)
    )

calorific_values_table

```






# C. Text Classification models: All training results
<br>

<!-- ############# text classification : Solar cells  -->

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false


classification_results <- readr::read_csv(
  "../data/tables/appendix/C_text_classification_solar_cells_results.csv"
#   "data/tables/appendix/C_text_classification_solar_cells_results.csv"
)

classification_results_table <- classification_results |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    recall = recall * 100,
    precision = precision * 100,
    f1_score = f1_score * 100,
    accuracy = accuracy * 100
  ) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(
    Classification_model = "Classification model",
    Feature_Engineering_method = "Feature engineering",
    Sampling_method = "Sampling method",
    Classification_problem = "Classification problem",
    recall = "Recall (%)",
    precision = "Precision (%)",
    f1_score = "F1-score (%)",
    accuracy = "Accuracy (%)"
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = c(
      recall,
      precision,
      f1_score,
      accuracy
    ),
    decimals = 2
  ) |>
  gt::sub_missing(
    columns = gt::everything(),
    missing_text = "—"
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(
      weight = "bold",
      size = gt::px(13)
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(
      columns = gt::everything()
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md(
        "Text classification results for **Solar Cells** Identification"
    )
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = c(
      Classification_model,
      Feature_Engineering_method,
      Sampling_method,
      Classification_problem
    )
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "right",
    columns = c(
      recall,
      precision,
      f1_score,
      accuracy
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_options(
    table.width = gt::pct(100),
    table.font.size = gt::px(12),
    data_row.padding = gt::px(5)
  )

classification_results_table

```

# D. Results - additional Information


In this appendix we give a clearer overview on what controls variables were included in each model. All variables and their functional form used in this analysis are stated in the summary statistic tables shown in Chapter @sec-data-chapter. All regressions that follow Equation @eq-main_2 share the same control variables. This includes Model 4 to 6 in Table  @tbl-main-results, all models in Table @tbl-market-segment-property-type, all models in Table @tbl-policy-effect, all models in Table @tbl-regression-robust-testing and all models in Table @tbl-robust-test-text-classification. These variables are listed here below in table @tbl-appendix-control-var-1:


<!-- ######################### TABLE 1 control variables ####################### -->
::: {#tbl-appendix-control-var-1}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false


control_variables <- readr::read_csv(
  "../data/tables/appendix/D_control_variables_table_1.csv"
#   "data/tables/appendix/D_control_variables_table_1.csv"
)

control_variables_table <- control_variables |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(
    Category_type = "Category",
    Control_variable = "Control variable",
    Cross_reference = "Cross-reference"
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(
      weight = "bold",
      size = gt::px(13)
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(
      columns = gt::everything()
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    footnote = gt::md(
      "**Note:** The only exception to these control variables applies to all models in Table 8, which focus on the property type segment. These models do not include a variable indicating property type."
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(
      columns = Cross_reference
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_header(
    title = "Control variables used in majority of the models"
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = gt::everything()
  ) |>
  gt::tab_options(
    table.width = gt::pct(100),
    table.font.size = gt::px(12),
    data_row.padding = gt::px(5)
  )





control_variables_table

```

:::


The only exception from the control variables used in this analysis are Models 1 to 3 in Table @tbl-main-results. The control variables included in each of these models are stated in Table @tbl-appendix-control-var-2 here below: 




<!-- ######################### TABLE 2 control variables ####################### -->

::: {#tbl-appendix-control-var-2}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false


control_variables_2 <- readr::read_csv(
  "../data/tables/appendix/D_control_variables_table_2.csv"
#   "data/tables/appendix/D_control_variables_table_2.csv"
)

control_variables_table_2 <- control_variables_2 |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(
    Category_type = "Category",
    Control_variable = "Control variable",
    Model_1 = "Model 1",
    Model_2 = "Model 2",
    Model_3 = "Model 3"
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(
      weight = "bold",
      size = gt::px(13)
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(
      columns = gt::everything()
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(
      columns = Model_1,
      rows = Model_1 == "YES"
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(
      columns = Model_2,
      rows = Model_2 == "YES"
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(
      columns = Model_3,
      rows = Model_3 == "YES"
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_header(
    title = "Control variables included in each model"
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = c(
      Category_type,
      Control_variable
    )
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(
      Model_1,
      Model_2,
      Model_3
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_options(
    table.width = gt::pct(100),
    table.font.size = gt::px(12),
    data_row.padding = gt::px(5)
  )


control_variables_table_2

```
